name: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS
summary: XML API for keygen, op, config, commit, and job polling. Show system info is the published PAN-OS example.
notes: XSOAR calls GET or POST /api/ with type=keygen, type=op, type=config, type=commit, and type=log. Show system info returns the XML example from the PAN-OS XML API docs. Other commands stay approximate. type=commit returns a job id. Poll that job with type=op and job=10. A log query uses type=log, then type=log and action=get. nlogs is capped at 500. The real show-jobs command is an XML cmd on type=op. This mock uses job= as a short poll. Export, import, version, and user-id are not modeled. The dummy key is not a firewall credential.
attribution: Show system info is the example on the PAN-OS XML API docs. Other fields follow demisto/content (MIT). See /presets/ATTRIBUTION.md.
